feeds.title: Denise Gaskins' Let's Play Math Blog
feeds.description: Math is a game, playing with ideas. My Let's Play Math blog is about the ongoing adventure of learning, teaching, and playing around with mathematics from preschool to Precalculus.

feeds.title: Math Coach's Corner Blog
feeds.description: Donna Bouche is a K-5 curriculum coordinator, co-author of the guided math workshop, and blogger at Math Coach's Corner. Her goal is to math fun and engaging for all students and ease the stress that some teachers associate with teaching math by providing highly interactive sessions and resources teachers can use.

feeds.title: Teaching with Jennifer Findley
feeds.description: Teaching math doesn't have to be difficult. In these articles, you will find resources to help with math centers, activities to engage your students, and strategies and tools to give you the confidence you need to teach all of your students.

feeds.title: Math Mama Writes
feeds.description: Sue VanHattum is the math mama and a college math teacher. She has written an anthology about math learning, and her blog focuses on all levels of math learning and posts range from book reviews to mastery tests to classroom games.

feeds.title: mathcoachblog
feeds.description: Bob Lochel is a math teacher who has been a teacher for 20 years. He is the most interested in effective technology integration in math classrooms, and developing lessons that challenge all learners to think mathematically. Bob organizes a math club at his high school, facilitates a number of math contests, and is a track and field official.

feeds.title: Teaching High School Math
feeds.description: Teaching High School Math is a blog offering classroom tips, teaching ideas, and resources for high school mathematics educators. The blog features creative activities like logic puzzles, mystery mosaics, and brain breaks to enhance student engagement.

feeds.title: My Math Education Blog
feeds.description: Integrating Problem Solving Seamlessly and Integrating Argumentation Seamlessly: Guest posts by Frank Cassano and Anya Sturm on highlighting essential habits of mind in math class. Making Connections in disciplinary courses is preferable to usually doomed attempts at interdisciplinary courses. Function Diagrams: I share my best function diagram lessons. Links to all the posts! feeds.title: Math = Love
feeds.description: Math = Love is a blog run by Sarah Carter, a high school math teacher from Oklahoma. She creates hands-on math activities, logic puzzles, and classroom resources designed to make math engaging and accessible to students and fellow teachers.

feeds.title: Reflections of a High School Math Teacher
feeds.description: I teach High School Mathematics and I love my job. I like to learn new things to become a better teacher. This is a record of my journey.

feeds.title: The Sassy Math Teacher Blog
feeds.description: A middle school math website catering to Virginia 7th grade and pre-algebra math teachers! Explore student engagement ideas and lesson tips!

feeds.title: Rethink Math Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Dedicated to Helping Math Teachers

feeds.title: Flip4Math Blog
feeds.description: Flip4Math blog provides practical strategies, engaging activities, and classroom resources tailored for 6th-grade math educators.

feeds.title: A Maths Teacher Writes
feeds.description: The author Jeff aims to engage, to communicate and to educate. He is a maths teacher. In A Maths Teacher Writes blog he covers his thoughts, his opinions, and ideas. Find ideas that will help you help your child improve their maths.

feeds.title: misscalcul8
feeds.description: A brand new teacher, Miss Cal.Q.L8 is learning how to do the whole education thing. Her blog is a reflection of that, and it's going to be fun to watch her grow through the next few years.

feeds.title: MathTeacherCoach
feeds.description: Articles cover a full year of 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th grade math, pre-algebra, algebra 1, geometry, or algebra 2 lesson plans, as well as trigonometry and pre-calculus lesson plans. MathTeacherCoach provides math teachers with the resources they need to be successful in the classroom.

feeds.title: MAthful Learners Blog
feeds.description: The rambles of a primary school teacher passionate about Mathematics. Follow this math blog written by an author Alison Hislop.

feeds.title: Marilyn Burns Math Blog
feeds.description: Math Solutions is dedicated to improving students' learning of mathematics by providing educators with the highest quality professional development services, products, and resources. Follow this blog that offers author Marilyn's current thinking about math education and her ongoing classroom experiences and learning.

feeds.title: EZMath Blog
feeds.description: Building a Thinking Classroom One Day At a Time

feeds.title: Mathodology Blog
feeds.description: Making Math Teachable, Learnable, and Enjoyable for All.

feeds.title: Yummy Math
feeds.description: Brian Marks is presently a math coach, specialist, and coordinator in Newton, Massachusetts. He taught math for ten years before his present role. He is the co-creator of YummyMath.com, a resource that provides teachers with engaging real-world math problems. His own childhood math education consisted of boring, meaningless skill and drill work. He is interested in how we can increase student engagement, critical thinking, and discourse in the math classroom.

feeds.title: I Speak Math
feeds.description: Hi! I am Julie. I am currently teaching Algebra 2 at a private school in North Carolina. I spend every spare moment planning, researching new ways to teach math, and reading blogs.
